posts.title: v0.19 — Playtest Fixes: Card Controls, Table Layout, and Inventory
posts.message: Improving card placement and controls, including overlapping dealer cards for better table visibility. Fixing card artwork inconsistencies and unique card inventory issues. Adding separate Inventory and Sleeves tabs to deck building.

posts.title: v0.18 — Pixel Art and Card Descriptions
posts.message: Introduced new pixel-art cards and sleeves, shop tabs for Cards, Sleeves, and Unique items, and card descriptions accessible by tapping and holding a visible card.

posts.title: v0.17 — Consistent Menus
posts.message: Updated menu screens with a consistent space background and navigation style. Main menu buttons now appear in one vertical column, with improved spacing and scrolling on smaller screens.

posts.title: v0.16 — Main Menu Refresh and Code Cleanup
posts.message: Added a new main menu background and simple white-text buttons. Cleaned up existing code to improve readability while preserving gameplay.
